write_up: Your path runs from supply chain programs at Dell to data center planning at Google and now terminal operations at Brightline Freight Partners. It’s common to list the duties of a current job while giving older accomplishments more room. Here, that makes it hard for a recruiter to judge your current operations leadership against the strong work that came before it.

Your Google line about cutting the forecast-to-delivery cycle works especially well: it names the change and the approval tracks you consolidated to make it happen. Your experience is easy to follow, but the Brightline role doesn’t show how big the terminal operation or your team is, or what has changed under your management.

Let’s start with the Austin terminal line, then add the team count and the kinds of issues you resolve. Your earlier work gives you a good model; bringing that same detail to the current role will make the full story more competitive.
